scope_summary: Write _shared/scripts/quality-floor-check.py: reads framework.yaml, runs quick_validate (8 checks) and lint_prompts (6 checks) per module per quality-floor-gates.md, reports results, supports --update-yaml and --write modes.
constraints: Exit code 0 = all modules pass, 1 = one or more fail, 2 = input error
--write is opt-in only; default is read-only
Must implement all checks exactly as specified in quality-floor-gates.md
